message.text:
q25.
CEL via `github.com/google/cel-go/cel` + `internal/filter/engine.go`; `internal/filter/AppendConditions` compiles CEL into a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders dialect-specific SQL/placeholders in each backend’s `memo.go` (`store/db/mysql/memo.go`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`).
